indication_area: Relapsed chronic lymphocytic leukemia (with rituximab); relapsed follicular B-cell NHL and SLL
geography: Worldwide (Gilead's worldwide product sales line, or the unlabelled total beneath its U.S., Europe and Other International / Rest of World lines)

approval_evidence.quote: ZYDELIG IDELALISIB ... TABLET;ORAL ... 07/23/2014 ORIG-1 Approval Type 1 - New Molecular Entity

launch_evidence.quote: Zydelig | 5,862 | — | 5,862 | — (first Zydelig sales line in Gilead's product sales table, three and nine months ended September 30, 2014, USD thousands)
launch_evidence.note: FDA approval on July 23, 2014; the second-quarter 2014 Form 10-Q describes 'pre-launch activities for Zydelig', so the first sales quarter is 2014Q3.

series_start_reason: Series starts 2014Q3, the first quarter with sales (USD thousands in that release; millions from the fourth-quarter 2014 release).
series_end_reason: Gilead's last Zydelig lines are in the fourth-quarter 2021 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/882095/000088209522000003/exhibit991earningspressrel.htm). From the first-quarter 2022 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/882095/000088209522000010/exhibit991earningspressrel.htm) the product is inside 'Other (7) – U.S. | 26 | 38', footnote '(7) Includes Cayston, Jyseleca, Ranexa and Zydelig.'; the Forms 10-K for 2022-2025 print Zydelig only in the patent-expiry table and no later 10-Q or release prints a Zydelig revenue line.
search_log: Listed every Gilead Sciences (CIK 882095) filing via data.sec.gov/submissions incl. the older 'files' pages (all forms); earnings releases are the 8-K/8-K/A filings with item 2.02 from 2009, each exhibit resolved from index.json; plus every 10-Q and 10-K from 2009.

Every table row whose first cell starts with Cayston, Tecartus, Veklury, Zydelig or Yeztugo followed by a figure was extracted from all of those documents (scan.py); for a product printed as regional lines ('<product> – U.S.', '– Europe', '– Other International' / 'Rest of World', or from 2026 '<product> | U.S.' then 'Europe', 'Rest of World'), the figure is the unlabelled worldwide total line beneath them, never a sum computed here.
Each quarter is read from the release that reports it as current (filed in the month after quarter end; Q4 in January/February).
Zydelig rows: single 'Zydelig' line in the releases for 2014Q3-2018Q1; unlabelled total beneath 'Zydelig – U.S./Europe/Other International' for 2018Q2-2021Q4.

Four-quarter sums 2015-2021: 132, 168, 149, 133, 103, 72, 62, each equal to the twelve-month column printed in that year's Q4 release; 2014Q3 (5.862) + 2014Q4 (17) = 22.9 against the printed full year 23.
